projects.name: THEYA.AUDIO
projects.title: THEYA.Audio
projects.description: A content-to-audio pipeline combining article extraction, structured sentence segmentation and neural text-to-speech behind a typed FastAPI interface.
projects.pitch: Turn passive reading into a sentence-aware listening experience.

logic.label: Processing pipeline
logic.expression: URL / text → extract → segment → synthesize → stream

projects.name: hr-screening101
projects.title: Conversational Voice Screening
projects.description: A documented event-driven architecture connecting Twilio telephony, ElevenLabs conversational AI, WebSocket sessions and post-call information extraction.
projects.pitch: Connect campaign context to a structured voice conversation.

logic.label: Documented workflow
logic.expression: campaign context → call → voice session → structured response

projects.name: mcp-el
projects.title: EduLoans MCP Decision Gateway
projects.description: A documented nine-tool MCP interface for education-loan profile scoring, eligibility pre-checks and university lookup, using schema-validated inputs and stdio transport.
projects.pitch: Make lending policy callable, inspectable and reusable.

logic.label: Documented scoring model
logic.note: U: university, A: academics, C: co-applicant. A rule-based pre-check, not a loan approval.

projects.name: V1.03-Chat-eduloans
projects.title: EduLoans Decision Workspace
projects.description: An interaction prototype spanning student intake, partner handoffs, document uncertainty and confirmation before reviewer actions. The portfolio walkthrough uses sample records and scripted responses.
projects.pitch: Bring policy inspection and human verification into one operational workspace.

logic.label: Scripted interaction model
logic.expression: intake → documents → verification → policy pre-check → reviewer action

projects.name: edulaons
projects.title: EduLoans Deterministic Matching
projects.description: A React application with a documented Supabase rule engine combining university matching, eligibility knockouts, course multipliers and intake-urgency adjustments.
projects.pitch: Translate lender policy into explainable product decisions.

logic.label: Documented score model
logic.note: University score, course multiplier and urgency adjustment; eligibility knockouts are evaluated separately.

projects.name: rocket-card-finder
projects.title: Rocket Card Intelligence
projects.description: A React product-discovery prototype combining bank, network and fee filters with spending-profile inputs, comparison controls and API-driven savings results.
projects.pitch: Turn spending patterns into a more informed card-discovery journey.

logic.label: Discovery workflow
logic.expression: spending profile + eligibility inputs → API results → comparison
logic.note: The repository shows the discovery interface; savings calculations depend on the connected service.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-equity-simulator
projects.title: EquitySim — Exit Economics
projects.description: An interactive preference-first payout model connecting exit proceeds, invested capital, preference multiples and common-pool ownership to a Chart.js allocation view.
projects.pitch: Make the liquidation-preference hurdle visible before the headline exit value.

logic.label: Simplified payout model
logic.expression: payout = max(0, exit − funding × preference) × ownership
logic.note: Ownership is a fraction of the remaining common pool. Excludes conversion, dilution and tax.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-json-atlas
projects.title: JSON Atlas — Structural Codegen
projects.description: A local-first structural inference pipeline that recursively builds a type registry from JSON and emits TypeScript interfaces, Python dataclasses and Go structs.
projects.pitch: Move from an unfamiliar API payload to typed language models.

logic.label: Code-generation pipeline
logic.expression: JSON → inferred structure → type registry → TypeScript / Python / Go

projects.name: magic-text-matcher
projects.title: Magic Text Matcher — Visual Regex
projects.description: An ECMAScript regex workbench with live match enumeration, capture-group highlighting, escaped HTML rendering and synchronized text overlays.
projects.pitch: Make pattern behaviour visible as the expression changes.

logic.label: Matching mechanism
logic.note: Global matching feeds the visual layer; complex nested capture rendering remains limited.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-csv-streamer
projects.title: StreamCSV — Browser Data Pipeline
projects.description: A chunk-oriented CSV-to-JSON experiment using File.stream(), TextDecoderStream, incremental progress accounting and Blob-based export.
projects.pitch: Transform files without making an upload the first step.

logic.label: Progress model
logic.note: The current delimiter parser is simple; quoted CSV fields need additional handling.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-color-palette-gen
projects.title: Procedural Colour Palette Generator
projects.description: A lightweight procedural interface that generates five random HEX swatches, with direct clipboard transfer and immediate interaction feedback.
projects.pitch: Compress colour exploration into a spacebar press and a click.

logic.label: Colour-generation logic
logic.note: Five independently generated swatches; space regenerates and click copies.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-tv-surf
projects.title: TV Surf — Stochastic Discovery
projects.description: A keyboard-driven channel-surfing experiment using curated video pools, randomized entry points, iframe orchestration and a transitional on-screen display.
projects.pitch: Recreate the serendipity of joining a programme already in progress.

projects.name: 2026-08-22-scrambl
projects.title: Scrambl — Deterministic Daily Play
projects.description: A date-seeded word game combining a Mulberry32 pseudorandom generator, seeded Fisher–Yates shuffling, timed letter assembly and shareable results.
projects.pitch: Use a reproducible daily challenge to make an individual game shareable.

logic.label: Calendar-seed model
logic.note: The calendar date seeds an 18-word challenge; each word has a 10-second timer.

projects.name: personal
projects.title: Portfolio Publishing Platform
projects.description: A Next.js implementation combining server rendering, cache-revalidated repository discovery, structured search metadata and PostgreSQL-backed CV-interest capture.
projects.pitch: Treat the portfolio as a product surface with a coherent publishing system.

logic.label: Publishing model
logic.expression: authored content + public repositories → rendered pages → cached delivery

projects.name: daily-build-log
projects.title: Daily Build Provenance Ledger
projects.description: A lightweight Markdown registry organizing the daily-build practice into dated project records with categories, descriptions and repository references.
projects.pitch: Keep each experiment attached to a date, purpose and source.

projects.name: small-tools-
projects.title: Small Tools — Exploration Backlog
projects.description: An idea-stage workspace for everyday personal utilities. The repository is currently empty; implementation has not been published.
projects.pitch: A home for the next small, useful tool.

projects.name: gpttest
projects.title: GPT Test — Experiment Starting Point
projects.description: An early experiment placeholder awaiting a published implementation. The repository is currently empty.
projects.pitch: A starting point for the next experiment.
